description: This minor course enhances the transmission capability of a transmission system by shunt and series compensation using static controllers, introducing the application of a variety of high power electronic controllers for active and reactive power in transmission lines, and the basics, modelling aspects, control and scope of different types of FACTS controllers.

syllabus.title: Introduction
syllabus.body: Concept of flexible AC transmission, reactive power control in electrical power transmission lines, uncompensated transmission line, series and shunt compensation, overview of FACTS devices - SVC, TCSC, UPFC and IPFC.

syllabus.title: Static Var Compensator and Applications
syllabus.body: Voltage control by SVC, advantages of slope in dynamic characteristics, influence of SVC on system voltage, applications - enhancement of transient stability, steady state power transfer, power system damping, prevention of voltage instability.

syllabus.title: Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor and Applications
syllabus.body: Operation of the TCSC, different modes of operation, modeling of TCSC, variable reactance model, modeling for stability studies, applications - improvement of the system stability limit, enhancement of system damping, voltage collapse prevention.

syllabus.title: Emerging FACTS Controllers
syllabus.body: Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM) - operating principle, V-I characteristics, Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC) - principle of operation, modes of operation, applications, modeling of UPFC for power flow studies.

outcomes: Understand various types of power controllers in transmission lines.
Understand the static VAR compensator and TCSC controller and their applications.
Understand the transient stability and modelling of STATCOM.
Learn the concept of coordination of FACTS controllers.
textbooks: R. Mohan Mathur and Rajiv K. Varma, Thyristor-Based FACTS Controllers for Electrical Transmission Systems, IEEE Press and John Wiley and Sons, 2002.
A. T. John, Flexible AC Transmission Systems, IEEE, 1999.
Narain G. Hingorani and Laszlo Gyugyi, Understanding FACTS: Concepts and Technology of Flexible AC Transmission Systems, Standard Publishers, Delhi, 2001.
